raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the plant’s intended energy conversion as chemical to kinetic (and even wrote “B) chemical energy to kinetic energy”), whereas coal plants are designed to convert chemical energy to electrical energy (option B). This conflated an intermediate step (mechanical/kinetic in the turbine) with the final output and mismatched the option letter with an incorrect description.
